notes.title: Update 01-08-2016
notes.notes:
[b] Dear Splooshies! [/b]

Being a small indie studio, we were so busy with getting our Gold version out that we actually forgot telling you guys about it.

So as we are patching a few issues today, we use the opportunity to make up for it today:

INTO THE BELLY OF THE BEAST is [b]not [/b] in Early Access any more! 
The [b]full game[/b] with all regions and the whole feature set is waiting for you! :)

[h1]Patch 1.8.2016 Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] "Immunity after death" time tweaked
[*] Wrong Achievement names fixed
[*] Some localization bugs fixed
[*] Bug in the "Lightfísh" level fixed
[*] "Roar of Beast" in Throat area tweaked
[*] Rare bug at Octokay Boss fight fixed
[*] Further performance optimization
[/list]

notes.title: Bodily Wanderings In Into The Belly Of The Beast
notes.notes:
Shh. Don’t tell anyone, but I found out about Into the Belly of the Beast [official site] via its Xbox release. It’s also in early access on Steam which is where I’m playing it and why I ended up spending part of my morning exploring an underwater creature’s cervix.

notes.title: New content: Into the Lung of the Beast
notes.notes:
Hey Guys,

today we released another update: we proudly introduce the region boss for the stomach region, the whole lung region and two new DNA abilities!

[b]Enjoy exploring The Belly Of The Beast![/b]

[h1]New content[/h1][list]	[*]Added Boss fight at the end of the stomach region[/*]	[*]Added lung region with 6 new playable levels[/*]	[*]Added a preview level for the end boss in the lung region[/*]	[*]Added new visuals for the range visualization of the heat bomb[/*]	[*]Added a new loading screen for the main menu[/*][/list][h1]Gameplay changes[/h1][list]	[*]Enemy swarms now prevent the player from casting abilities while stunning the player[/*]	[*]Swarms now react correctly to the player's DNA status[/*]	[*]"Accept" using bite button should work in all menus now[/*]	[*]Added clock ticking sounds and visuals to time-based puzzles[/*]	[*]Adjusted spitter traps balancing[/*]	[*]If the player fulfills the requirements for a health upgrade, any penalties will be cleared at that moment[/*]	[*]The menu point "Back to Heart" is now only accessible after finishing the tutorial[/*]	[*]Cool down added on elementpods[/*]	[*]Rebalanced stun durations on enemies who are stunned by an electro bomb[/*]	[*]Rebalanced the DNA-usage-buff from the yellow DNA collectables[/*][/list][h1]Bugfixes[/h1][list]	[*]Added missing sounds for some traps[/*]	[*]Fixed a bug where respawning didn't work as intended[/*]	[*]Fixed a bug where the swarm didn't stun Sploosh correctly[/*]	[*]Fixed overlay issues in tutorial text[/*]	[*]Fixed a bug where enemy worm could push buttons out of their anchors accidentaly[/*]	[*]Fixed blowfish animations[/*]	[*]Fixed a bug where selection sounds didn't appear in the in-game pause menu[/*]	[*]Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck in one of the puzzle in the second stomach level[/*]	[*]Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck while carrying a weighted ball[/*][/list][h1]
Localisation[/h1][list]	[*]Fixed bugs in the Spanish localisation[/*][/list]

[list]

    [*]Sound: (Skeleton props)
    [*]Sound: Roar Event refinements
    [*]Sound: Stun Sound
    [*]Gameplay: Biter Enemy behavior fixes

[/list]
